headline: Approved two NOIs and one COC, continued twelve projects, withdrew one NOI, and kept two enforcement orders in place
summary: The Conservation Commission reviewed many Notices of Intent for projects along the waterfront and wetlands, approving work at 11, 17, & R Dory Road and 62 Woodward Avenue, and closing out certificates of compliance at 498 Washington Street and 64 Rocky Neck Avenue. Most other projects, including several on Atlantic Street, Woodward Avenue, and Wingaersheek Road, were continued to future meetings for more information. The Commission also discussed ongoing enforcement orders at 137 Wingaersheek Road and other sites, declining to lift the EO at 137 Wingaersheek Road, and a houseboat violation at 17 Landing Road.
